maddeler.t: From Aramaic יַרקָאנָא / ܝܰܪܩܳܢܳܐ (yarqānā). Contaminated in Arabic with the root ء ر ق (ʔ r q) related to sleeplessness.

maddeler.e:
يرقان (form I)
# يَرِقَّانِ (yariqqāni) /ja.riq.qaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of رَقَّ (raqqa)
# يُرَقَّانِ (yuraqqāni) /ju.raq.qaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of رَقَّ (raqqa)
# يَرُقَّانِ (yaruqqāni) /ja.ruq.qaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of رَقَّ (raqqa)
